data.title: How Much Bitcoin Could Elon Musk Control if Tesla and SpaceX Merge?
data.description: Tesla and SpaceX have both formed special committees to weigh a merger, and both sit on Bitcoin bought at very different times. Combine the stashes and a single board could hold a decision that rattles a market already under pressure.
